subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the transfer beam between Structural General Notes

messages.text: The transfer beam reinforcement shown in Structural General Notes S-001 conflicts with additional #5 ties noted in Sheet S-301. We need an urgent response on this; please treat it as time-sensitive. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding any current pour. We need a response within one business day, if at all possible. Some on our side would call this more pressing than others do -- it's a judgment call either way.
Proceed with additional #5 ties per Sheet S-301; Structural General Notes S-001 is superseded. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding any current pour.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- additional #5 ties -- apply at every transfer beam on this level, not just the one called out in Structural General Notes S-001?
